notes.title: The Demon Stone Update 1.1.3
notes.content: [p]Function: [/p][p]-Add sound effects for opening the interface [/p][p]-Add sound effects for equipment and props [/p][p]-Optimize the information display of task functionality [/p][p]-The text will now be displayed word for word [/p][p]Content: [/p][p]-Add 6 new equipment [/p][p]Fixes: [/p][p]-Fix the issue where characters cannot return to the main interface when they die [/p][p]-Fix the issue where the icon for accepting tasks is sometimes displayed in an incorrect position [/p][p]-Fix the issue of incorrect actual attributes of some equipment [/p][p]-Fix the issue of incorrect selling price for peeled snake skin [/p][p]-Fix the issue of incorrect selling prices for scorpion shells[/p]

notes.title: The Demon Stone Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
1.1.0： 
Function: 
-Added display of average equipment level in the character information interface 
-Display the icon for accepting new tasks 
-Display the completion quantity of new task objectives 
-Initial armor for newly added characters 
Content: 
-Add 3 new tasks 
-Add 3 new equipment 
-Add 3 new items 
-Add 2 new NPC characters 
-Add 2 new enemy characters 
Numerical value and balance: 
-Basic weapon mission bonus of 25 experience points 
-The experience reward for the Wolf King mission has been increased from 150 to 200 
-The mission to eliminate wolves has increased the number of wolves killed from 5 to 6, and the experience reward has increased from 50 to 100 
-The experience reward for sparring tasks has been increased from 120 to 200 
-The experience reward for wild wolves has been increased from 20 to 30 
-The experience reward for bandit swordsmen has been increased from 48 to 50 
-The experience reward of the bandit mage has been increased from 48 to 50 
frame: 
-The original painting of the Palace of Rites has been updated 
-Update of Wild Original Paintings in Weiluo Village 
-Optimize the appearance of linen shirts 
-Optimize the appearance of linen shorts 
-Optimize the appearance of linen shoes 
-Optimize the appearance of the bandit's shield 
-Optimize the appearance of soldiers' chest armor in Baishi Town 
-Optimize the appearance of leg armor for soldiers in Baishi Town 
-Optimize the appearance of soldiers' waistbands in Baishi Town 
-Optimize the appearance of soldiers' boots in Baishi Town 
Problem fix: 
-Fix the issue of abnormal jumping caused by incomplete interaction in the task of clearing abandoned mines

notes.title: The Demon Stone Update 1.0.5
notes.content:
1.0.5： 
Gameplay: 
-Added a bandit's shield 
-The rapid shooting of marksman profession increases non critical damage from attack power to attack power+agility * 10 
frame: 
-Optimize the appearance of the soldier captain in Baishi Town 
Problem fix: 
-Fix the issue where the defense posture of the shield guard profession always takes effect once activated 
-Fix the issue where enemies in abandoned mine dungeons sometimes have incorrect stamina values 
-Fix the issue of Gail's leather gloves not being sellable 
-Fix the problem of unsold waist belts for soldiers in Baishi Town

notes.title: The Demon Stone Update 1.0.4
notes.content:
1.0.4： 
Gameplay: 
-Shield Guard's defense posture skill has increased from 30% damage reduction to 35% damage reduction (damage value rounded down) 
-Add Gail's leather gloves 
-Add waist belts for soldiers in Baishi Town 
frame: 
-Optimize the appearance of leg guards for soldiers in Baishi Town 
Problem fix: 
-Fixed the issue of abnormal character display in the character panel when working on abandoned mine replicas 
-Fix the issue of abnormal audio playback when equipping the iron ring 
-Fixed the issue where equipping iron rings increases their quantity infinitely when there are multiple iron rings
